source_evidence: in all cases, you should always feel free to ask questions about how and how much your adviser is being paid.
answer: Investment professionals are paid for their services, and some fees may be less obvious than others. Before working with a broker or adviser, ask how they are paid and how much you will pay. If a fee is stated as a percentage, ask what that amount means in dollars so you can understand the cost. Comparing the prices and services offered by different professionals can also help you evaluate your options.
